acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
cleavage agent: in-gel digestion with Asp-N at 37 °C for overnight... subjected to in-gel digestion with Lys-C and Trypsin at 37 °C for overnight
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 35%; normalized collision energy of 30
Fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energy of 35%... HCD fragmentation with normalized collision energy of 30
enrichment method: ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads
fractionation method: the Lbpro*-treated reaction was separated by SDS-PAGE
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos; Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos

NanoLC−nanoESI-MS/MS analysis was performed on a nanoAcquity system (Waters, Milford, MA) connected to the LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer... NanoLC−nanoESI-MS/MS analysis was performed on an EASY-nLC™ 1200 system connected to an Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer
labeling: For label-free quantification, precursor ions intensities were extracted using Minora Feature Detector
precursor tolerance: mass accuracy of 10 ppm for the parent ion
ptm: carbamidomethyl (C) variable; oxidation (M) variable; ubiquitinylation (K) variable
variable modifications set as carbamidomethyl (C), oxidation (M), ubiquitinylation (K)
